figures.caption: FIGURE 4. Workflow for creating similarity maps between videos 𝑽𝑴and 𝑽𝑬. For each frame of the videos, the proposed method generates image captions 𝑪𝑴and 𝑪𝑬using a VLM 𝑴𝐜𝐚𝐩. To improve the quality of the generated descriptions, the method vectorizes images and captions, compares their similarities to select the closest caption, and uses it as the cleaned caption. Then, the method vectorizes the cleaned captions ?̃?𝑴and ?̃?𝑬using a text encoder 𝝓𝑻, calculates the similarity between each pair of vectors 𝐕𝐞𝐜𝑴and 𝐕𝐞𝐜𝑬, and creates a frame similarity map 𝑺𝐟𝐦𝐚𝐩whose elements are the calculated similarities.
